name: Recreational Boating Permits
description:
This dataset records recreational boating permits issued across five years, from 2013 to 2017, broken down by company or location. Each row represents one company's permit activity for a given year, with five named entities (Cannonsville, Neversink, Pepacton, Schoharie, and a Totals row) appearing in the data. The columns capture the total number of permits issued along with counts of seasonal tags, temporary tags, and several boat types: canoes, kayaks, rowboats, sailboats, and sculls. Values are whole numbers, and the data appears complete with no missing entries.

The dataset can be used to compare permit volumes and boat-type mix across companies and over time, identify which locations issue the most permits, and see how demand for different watercraft such as kayaks versus sailboats varies.
